description: This dataset provides 20 human‑observed occurrences of the Australian shrub Banksia robur, recorded in Queensland and New South Wales. Each record includes GBIF and iNaturalist identifiers, a complete taxonomic hierarchy (Plantae → Tracheophyta → Magnoliopsida → Proteales → Proteaceae → Banksia → robur), and the scientific name with authorship. Precise geographic coordinates are supplied, with latitudes from –33.91 to –25.5 ° and longitudes up to 153.13 °, together with coordinate‑uncertainty measurements in metres. Temporal data span 2010‑2026, captured at day, month and year resolution. All entries are still‑image media, flagged for rounded coordinates, and released under a CC BY‑NC 4.0 licence. The collection is ideal for mapping the species’ distribution, analysing phenology, and supporting conservation assessments of Banksia robur.
